findings.finding: After the ABB and the Q3 quarter-end, the CFO bought 1,381 shares on 2026-09-30 (VWAP 9.68) and 1,000 on 2026-10-08 (VWAP 10.12), and another senior manager 1,000 on 2026-10-01 at 9.90, open-market, before the closed period: small (about EUR 33k in total) but bought with sight of the quarter's monthly figures.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance where insider buying preceded a print on this name; earlier buys were IPO allocations (April) and early-June buys before the Q2 beat (+7.4% on 2026-08-20).
findings.why_not_priced: The buys are public and tiny, and read on the forum as support after the ABB ('Sisäpiiri ostoksilla?'); the stock has drifted from 10.1 to 9.75 since, so if the market had taken them as a signal on Q3 the price would have held above the CFO's 10.12 entry.

findings.finding: The company's own H1 statement says earnings are H2-weighted and it entered H2 with a record 169.6 MEUR backlog, while Inderes holds Q3 EBITA flat on Q2 at 6.5 MEUR; against that, Q2 was lifted by deliveries carried over from Q1, so the organic rate falls back.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 clearly beat Inderes ('Aurooran Q2-luvut ylittivät ennusteemme selvästi') and the stock rose 7.42% on the day; Q1 2026 (no Inderes estimate yet) +3.71%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: Inderes models the H2 weighting (H2e 13.6 vs H1 8.2) and the backlog. What is left is that the Q3 estimate does not step up from Q2, which a single-analyst name can miss in either direction; with that much already in the bar it stays small.
findings.independence: Inderes preview restating 'Auroora has commented that within the year, its earnings are weighted towards H2': https://www.inderes.fi/en/analyst-comments/auroora-q326-preview-growth-engine-firing-on-both-cylinders

findings.finding: Three acquisitions signed after the quarter (Labko ~10.5 MEUR, Coating Source ~6 MEUR at ~17% EBIT, BRIX ~8 MEUR at >10% EBITA) add about 9% to Inderes's 2026e 267 MEUR revenue base. Inderes says it will put them into its forecasts only at the Q3 report, so an estimate upgrade is due in the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The deal days moved +1.91% (10-27 Labko), +4.07% (10-28 Coating Source) and +3.08% (11-09 BRIX), so the stock already paid for the announcements.
findings.why_not_priced: The deals are public and were bought on their own days, but the only covering estimate excludes them until the Q3 update, so the 2027 numbers the multiple is quoted on rise mechanically after the report. That is small and partly anticipated.
